episodes.title: Introdução à obra de Franz Kafka
episodes.description: Online undergraduate course at Universidade Estadual de Campinas (Unicamp), published as a podcast on Spotify. 15-episode series on Kafka’s literary works, critical reception, and intellectual context, including conversations with Laís Oliveira, Renato Faria, and Susana Kampff Lages.

episodes.title: Sonhos Intranquilos
episodes.description: Literary podcast hosted, produced and edited by Tomaz Amorim, featuring in-depth conversations with contemporary Brazilian authors about their recent books. The eight-episode series explores literary form, politics, race, music, the sacred, and the intersections between literature and society.
